library(tidyverse)

# Overview {.tabset .tabset-pills}

### Background
An initial patient pathway has been produced and visualised for discussion with relevant pathway leads and clinical staff.

### Methods
- Data were downloaded from the [Cancer Waiting Times system](https://nwwcancerwaitingtimes.sdcs.digital.nhs.uk/Download#). 
- Data were extracted for West Midlands commissioned patients with a **primary diagnosis of gynacological - uterine** cancer that had a first definitive treatment start date (for a new primary cancer) between `r min_treatment_date` and `r max_treatment_date`. 
- Relevant FDS criteria were applied using [Report 19.1- 28 Day General FDS](https://digital.nhs.uk/data-and-information/data-collections-and-data-sets/data-collections/cancerwaitingtimescwt/report-guidance), along with 31-day [Report 25.1 - 31 Day General Treatment Standard (Tumour) Report](https://digital.nhs.uk/data-and-information/data-collections-and-data-sets/data-collections/cancerwaitingtimescwt/report-guidance) and 62-day [Report 26.1 - 62 Day General Standard (Tumour) Report](https://digital.nhs.uk/data-and-information/data-collections-and-data-sets/data-collections/cancerwaitingtimescwt/report-guidance) rules for patient inclusion to show the patient journey from FDS, to 31-day and 62-day pathways. 
- FDS waiting time adjustments were **not applied** to reflect the real patient journey, which includes both system performance and elements of patient choice.
- Patient pathways are visualised to show the 30%, 50%, 80% and 100% most frequently taken patient pathways.
- Patient pathways are visualised to show absolute patient numbers, relative patient numbers (%) and median waiting times between pathway events.
- Further information on Cancer Waiting Times criteria is found via the [CWT Guidance](https://www.england.nhs.uk/long-read/national-cancer-waiting-times-monitoring-dataset-guidance/). 

### Results
See graphs below

### Conclusions

### Limitations
- Waiting times reflect the real patient journey, which includes both system performance and elements of patient choice. 
- The patient pathways show the patient journey from FDS to 31-day and 62-day pathways. Patients without criteria for these patient pathways are not visualised.

## The 30% most frequent pathways {.tabset .tabset-pills}
* * * * *
### Absolute patient numbers

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, dev='svglite', fig.ext='svg', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
process_map(process_30per)
```

### Relative patient numbers (%)

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, dev='svglite', fig.ext='svg', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
process_map(process_30per, frequency("relative-case"))
```

### Median waiting times

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, dev='svglite', fig.ext='svg', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
process_map(process_30per, performance(median, "days"))
```
